note: Safety invariants 1-3. These resources are shown by a deterministic rule only. Never a chatbot, never AI, never gated behind sign-up or test completion. Every number and every hours window here MUST be re-verified before launch and on a recurring schedule.
hoursRule: Hours are never invented. A resource either carries an `hours` array read directly from `sourceUrl` on `sourceReadOn`, or it carries none and the panel prints the honest fallback with the link. A window is ISO weekday numbers (1 = Monday .. 7 = Sunday) in local wall-clock time in `timezone`. A day that appears twice is a line that closes for a break.
englishNote: There is no English-language MIELI crisis line since 23.3.2026. Until MIELI says what to list instead, an English reader's panel leads with 112, which answers in English, then the Finnish 24/7 line with a note that it is answered in Finnish. The panel sorts by the person's chosen support language, falling back to the interface language before they have chosen one. See D-21.

triggers.description: Any instrument crisisItem firing (e.g. PHQ-9 item 9 >= 1) interrupts the flow before scoring continues.
The always-present crisis control on every screen.

pendingVerification.note: Numbers MIELI publishes that Reitti does NOT show, because we could not establish what language each serves or what its hours are from a page we read directly. Deliberately not in `resources`: the component never reads this key. A number in a crisis panel under the wrong language label is the failure this whole change exists to fix. Each is a question in the email to MIELI.

numbers.why: DISCONTINUED. Reitti showed this as the English crisis line from 2026-09-17 to 2026-09-18, on the strength of MIELI's 12.5.2025 announcement of new opening hours. That announcement was superseded: MIELI's own news item 'New ways to receive support in English' (https://mieli.fi/en/news/new-ways-to-receive-support-in-english/, 24.3.2026) says 'MIELI Crisis Helpline in English is open for the last time on Monday, March 23rd, from 4 pm to 8 pm.' English support moved to appointment-based chat and phone or video counselling, which is in the directory as `mieli-chat-en` and is not a crisis line. Held here rather than deleted until MIELI says what a website should list for English: question 1 in docs/mieli-verification-email.md.

No MIELI page read directly listed it. Ask MIELI what 0113 is now.
